selection.rule: An npm record is selected when each present Bun lockfile os/cpu field exactly matches linux/x64; absent fields match. Bun lockfiles have no libc field, so both x64 GNU and musl bindings are selected.

lifecycle.note: Only esbuild@0.21.5 contains a dependency install lifecycle script. Bun 1.3.13 reports zero untrusted scripted dependencies and treats esbuild as default-trusted.

offlineReplay.note: A fresh detached checkout completed all three exact frozen installs from the project-materialized WSL2 ext4 cache in the locked Ubuntu container with --network none and the cache mounted read-only. Exact executable modes, all lockfiles, and the Git tree remained unchanged.
